planets.name: EPIC 229004835 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of EPIC 229004835 with a 16.1-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: EPIC 229004835 b was found in 2023 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around EPIC 229004835. Its orbit and size follow Bonomo et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
